chunks: And Sama'ah ibn Mihran narrated, saying:
I was eating with Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he said: “O Sama'ah, eat with praise and gratitude, not eating with silence.”

key_terms.آكُلُ: I eat; the act of eating mentioned in the report
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, the kunyah of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.حَمْدًا: praise and gratitude, referring to thanking Allah while eating
key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the narrator being addressed by the Imam
key_terms.صَمْتًا: silence, meaning eating without verbal praise or gratitude

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about praising Allah while eating?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the etiquette of eating with praise and gratitude to Allah rather than remaining silent. It emphasizes that eating should be accompanied by conscious remembrance and thankful acknowledgment of divine blessing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I was eating with Abu Abdullah (as), and Imam (as) said:
"O Sama'ah, eat with gratitude and praise, not with eating and silence."
